Juan C.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Colors in SNP plot
parts:
The genes colors are arbitrary. That part of the plot is made by plot_genes(). The argument colors: “Vectors of colors, used sequentially and then re-used.”

karl
